notes: Bedrock has no level-name-derived folder set the way Java does -- worldFolderNames(for:)'s Bedrock branch (WorldSlotManager.swift:248-255) always returns the single fixed name "worlds" if that directory exists at the server root, and an empty list otherwise (exercised separately below by the no-world-folders case). Contrast with create-slot-java-zips-main-nether-end, which zips three level-name-derived folders instead of one fixed one -- this pair pins that the create path branches correctly on server_type.
